goal: The mirror of DLG-06: a modify that is ALLOWED. A confirmed bottle service booking for 5 on the night of 12 July. The guest writes 5 days out, inside high season but outside the 4-day deadline, and the party grows 5 -> 7. He has two live bookings on that same night, so the agent must ask which one before touching anything. The change goes through: the EUR 250 already paid carries over, only EUR 50 per extra head is added, and the minimum spend is recalculated on seven. The dinner booking earlier the same evening is left alone.
policy_refs: policy.md #6 when the venue is full
policy.md #10 when a change is allowed
policy.md #10 what happens to the money

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: hi! we need a bigger table for Sunday, we are going to be 7 now

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Hello Mr Pappas. You have two bookings that night - dinner at 19:30 for 4, and bottle service at 00:00 for 5. Which of the two should be 7?

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: the bottle service one, the late table

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Found it - bottle service, Sunday 12 July at 00:00, currently 5 people. Sunday is 5 days away, so the change is allowed, and there is room for seven. Two figures move. The minimum spend at that hour is EUR 400 per person, so EUR 2,800 for seven. And the deposit goes from EUR 250 to EUR 350 - EUR 50 for each of the two extra people, so EUR 100 more. Shall I make the change?
must_not_say: is too close to the date

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Changed - bottle service for 7 on Sunday 12 July at 00:00. Your table was never released; it is the same booking, still confirmed. Here is the link for the extra EUR 100: {payment_link}. The whole EUR 350 comes off the bill that night.

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: so I am not paying the 250 twice?

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: No. The EUR 250 you already paid stays on the booking - a deposit follows a booking when it is changed. You add EUR 100 for the two extra people, and all EUR 350 comes off the bill.

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: and the dinner at 19:30 that evening, still for 4?

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Untouched - dinner at 19:30 on Sunday 12 July, still for 4. I changed only the bottle service booking. The early sitting has no minimum spend.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Thank you Mr Pappas. Please arrive about 15 minutes before each sitting. See you on Sunday.
